name: measured-even
title: Measured: no signal
description: Rules that fired about as often on human prose as on AI prose. They carry no information about authorship either way on this corpus. Still useful as style flags, which is what they were built for.

rules.name: Stranded auxiliary contrast
rules.description: A clause that lands on a bare auxiliary for the reversal: “The tool died; the data didn’t.”, “Reading mostly passed … Writing didn’t”, “Maybe it wouldn’t have.”
rules.suggest: Complete the clause. The bare auxiliary is a rhythm trick, not information.

hit: The tool died; the data didn't.
miss: The test passed and the build was green.

rules.evidence: On the audit corpus: 2 hits in 2/18 human documents, 2 in 2/18 AI documents.

rules.name: “Not just X, but Y”
rules.description: Negative parallelisms: “not just X, but (also) Y”, “not only … but …”, and the “it’s not X — it’s Y” contrast.
rules.suggest: Pick the accurate half. Negative parallelism inflates without adding.

hit: This is not just a tool, but a philosophy.
It was not merely mistaken, but dangerous.
Not only fast but also reliable.
It’s not a bug — it’s a feature.
miss: She was not sure about the plan.
not only because performance differences impair the system, but the effect is small

rules.note: Tightened from upstream, which also matched "not only" negating a clause rather than a thing. Over 18 matched document pairs this cut hits on human prose from 5 to 3 while keeping all 3 on AI prose. See research/audit.md.
rules.evidence: On the audit corpus: 3 hits in 3/18 human documents, 3 in 2/18 AI documents.

rules.name: “It’s important to note”
rules.description: Didactic hedging: “it is important to note that”, “it’s worth noting”, “it should be noted”, plus the “worth pausing / considering / asking” family.
rules.suggest: Delete the hedge and state the fact.

hit: It is important to note that timing matters.
It’s worth noting the fees are separate.
It should be noted that this changed in 2020.
It's worth pausing on that number.
It is worth asking who benefits.

rules.evidence: On the audit corpus: 1 hit in 1/18 human documents, 1 in 1/18 AI documents.

rules.name: robust
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: robust.
rules.suggest: Name the specific strength: what does it survive?
rules.note: single ordinary word; expect false positives in engineering prose
rules.evidence: On the audit corpus: 1 hit in 1/18 human documents, 2 in 1/18 AI documents.
